message:
Running command: cd /workspace; cat > /workspace/candidate_trace.json << 'EOF'
[
  {"step": 1, "file": "fuzz_cfg_parser.c", "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 23, "var": "data", "code": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput(const uint8_t *data, size_t size)", "note": "Entry point: attacker-controlled raw bytes are passed in as the fuzz input."},
  {"step": 2, "file": "fuzz_cfg_parser.c", "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 25, "var": "size", "code": "if (size < 50) return 0;", "note": "The 50-byte PoC passes the size gate, so the input proceeds to be written to a temp file."},
  {"step": 3, "file": "fuzz_cfg_parser.c", "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 34, "var": "data", "code": "fwrite(data, size, 1, fp);", "note": "The raw input (first byte 0x00) is written verbatim to the temp config file, preserving the leading NUL byte."},
  {"step": 4, "file": "fuzz_cfg_parser.c", "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 38, "var": "filename", "code": "readcfgfile(filename);", "note": "The temp file path is handed to the config parser, which reads it line by line."},
  {"step": 5, "file": "src/cfgparse.c", "function": "readcfgfile", "line": 1870, "var": "thisline", "code": "while (fgets(thisline + readbytes, linesize - readbytes, f) != NULL)", "note": "fgets reads the first line into the malloc'd buffer. Because the first byte is 0x00, the line's effective string length is 0."},
  {"step": 6, "file": "src/cfgparse.c", "function": "readcfgfile", "line": 1891, "var": "end", "code": "end = line + strlen(line);", "note": "strlen(line) returns 0 since line[0] is NUL, so end == line; the line is treated as empty."},
  {"step": 7, "file": "src/cfgparse.c", "function": "readcfgfile", "line": 1917, "var": "*(end-1)", "code": "if (*(end-1) == '\\n')", "note": "With end == line, *(end-1) dereferences thisline[-1], one byte before the malloc'd buffer, causing the heap-buffer-overflow READ 1 (ASAN)."}
]
EOF
echo "Trace written"; python3 -c "import json; json.load(open('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')); print('Valid JSON')"
